new_findings.claim: packet-completeness-review.schema.json does not derive accepted from findings; a review with an unresolved material or critical finding can be marked accepted by omitting the finding ID from unresolvedMaterialFindingIds.
evidence: packet-completeness-review.schema.json: findings[].severity enum includes material and critical; findings[].disposition enum includes unresolved

packet-completeness-review.schema.json: allOf only constrains unresolvedMaterialFindingIds maxItems 0 when accepted is true; there is no constraint that every finding with severity material/critical and disposition unresolved appears in unresolvedMaterialFindingIds
methodology.md: 'The packet is eligible for derivation only when the review is accepted and has no unresolved material finding.'
new_findings.failure_mode: An incomplete or contaminated packet can pass the completeness gate and be sent to blind derivation, undermining source-only blindness and potentially producing false clean comparisons.
new_findings.required_fix: Add a schema or validator cross-field constraint: if any finding has severity material/critical and disposition unresolved, accepted must be false and its findingId must appear in unresolvedMaterialFindingIds; conversely unresolvedMaterialFindingIds must reference existing unresolved material/critical findings.
new_findings.test_or_negative_control: Mutation test: completeness review with a material finding disposition unresolved, unresolvedMaterialFindingIds empty, and accepted true must be rejected.

new_findings.claim: blind-derivation.schema.json does not require one returned result per submitted packet unit in the same order, despite methodology claiming it does.
evidence: blind-derivation.schema.json: unitResults is array minItems 1; items only require auditUnitId string minLength 1; no uniqueItems, no minItems/maxItems tied to packetPath, no order constraint
methodology.md: 'blind-derivation.schema.json requires one returned result per submitted unit, in the same order.'
test summary does not list an omitted, duplicated, or reordered unit mutation
new_findings.failure_mode: A blind derivation batch can omit, duplicate, or reorder unit results and still validate; skipped lanes can advance to comparison/final, recreating F-07/F-001.
new_findings.required_fix: Enforce in the validator or schema that the multiset and order of unitResults[].auditUnitId exactly equals the referenced packet's auditUnitIds; reject duplicates and omissions before any progress transition.
new_findings.test_or_negative_control: Mutation test: blind derivation with packet auditUnitIds [A,B] but unitResults [A], [B,A], or [A,A] must be rejected.

new_findings.claim: audit-result.schema.json requires rootCauseId, authorityOverride, and hiddenDefault fields but does not tie their values to severity or classification, so material/critical discrepancies can have null rootCauseId and authority-inversion/hidden-default rows can have false flags.
evidence: audit-result.schema.json: discrepancy required rootCauseId type ['string','null']; authorityOverride type boolean; hiddenDefault type boolean

audit-result.schema.json: no allOf requiring rootCauseId non-null for severity material/critical/blocked, authorityOverride true for classification authority-inversion, or hiddenDefault true for classification hidden-default
methodology.md: 'Material and critical discrepancies require a stable rootCauseId. Authority inversions and hidden defaults have mandatory Boolean flags independent of severity wording.'
new_findings.failure_mode: A material/critical discrepancy can be recorded without a root cause, defeating recurring-pattern detection; an authority inversion or hidden default can be recorded with false flags, defeating the decision gate's no-authority-override/no-hidden-default checks.
new_findings.required_fix: Add conditional schema or validator constraints: severity material/critical/blocked requires non-null rootCauseId; classification authority-inversion requires authorityOverride true; classification hidden-default requires hiddenDefault true; and the validator must derive status consistency from these values.
new_findings.test_or_negative_control: Mutation test: material discrepancy with rootCauseId null, authority-inversion with authorityOverride false, and hidden-default with hiddenDefault false must each be rejected.

new_findings.claim: Reviewer responsePath and responseSha256 are not conditionally paired in any reviewer definition, so a non-null responsePath can be recorded with null responseSha256.
evidence: packet-completeness-review.schema.json $defs.reviewer: responsePath type ['string','null'], responseSha256 type ['string','null'] pattern, no allOf
blind-derivation.schema.json $defs.reviewer: same
audit-result.schema.json $defs.reviewer: same
methodology.md: 'Packet, completeness-review, prompt, model response, and blind hashes remain independently addressable.'
new_findings.failure_mode: A model response artifact can be referenced without a hash, breaking independent addressability and allowing unverified response content to influence reviews.
new_findings.required_fix: Add an allOf to each reviewer definition: if responsePath is a string then responseSha256 must be a string; if responseSha256 is a string then responsePath must be a string; null only together.
new_findings.test_or_negative_control: Mutation test: reviewer with responsePath non-null and responseSha256 null must be rejected.

new_findings.claim: source-packet.schema.json leaves free-text metadata fields unconstrained and allows exactText to be empty or null for official-text evidence, so downstream conclusions or hollow evidence can pass the closed schema.
evidence: source-packet.schema.json: scope type string minLength 1 with no enum or pattern; authorityOrder items string minLength 1 with no enum; sourceDocuments[].authority/version/role type string minLength 1 with no enum
source-packet.schema.json: evidence.exactText type ['string','null'] with no minLength and no conditional requirement for evidenceKind official-text
methodology.md: 'The closed schema permits only ... neutral audit IDs and source-local printed labels.'
new_findings.failure_mode: A packet can carry concise-rule conclusions in scope, authorityOrder, or role, or include an official-text evidence item with empty/null exactText and no visual, contaminating the blind reviewer or hollowing the evidence base.
new_findings.required_fix: Constrain scope, authorityOrder, and sourceDocuments[].role to closed enums or patterns of source-local/authority metadata; require nonempty exactText for official-text evidence unless a visual path with hash is present; add a validator check that packet free-text fields contain no downstream rule IDs or conclusion fields without imposing an n-gram ban.
new_findings.test_or_negative_control: Mutation test: packet with scope containing a concise-rule conclusion, or official-text evidence with exactText '' and visualEvidencePath null, must be rejected.

new_findings.claim: blind-derivation.schema.json requires actorDecisionOwner, visibility, and orderedOperations but permits empty values, and omits required fields for targets, cardinality, decline rights, costs, finite-supply, impossible-instruction, and partial-resolution behavior that the methodology says the reviewer derives.
evidence: blind-derivation.schema.json $defs.requirement: required actorDecisionOwner, visibility, orderedOperations; actorDecisionOwner and visibility are type string with no minLength; orderedOperations is array items string with no minItems
blind-derivation.schema.json $defs.requirement has no properties for targets, cardinality, decline rights, costs, finite-supply, impossible-instruction, or partial-resolution

methodology.md: 'The reviewer derives: ... actor, decision owner, targets, cardinality, and decline rights; ... costs and ordered operations; finite-supply, impossible-instruction, and partial-resolution behavior...'
new_findings.failure_mode: A blind derivation can omit key behavioral dimensions or record empty actor/visibility/ordered operations and still validate, producing hollow requirements that later compare as clean.
new_findings.required_fix: Add minLength/minItems constraints and structured fields, or required nonempty text, for the enumerated dimensions; alternatively narrow the methodology claim to what the schema actually enforces.
new_findings.test_or_negative_control: Mutation test: derived requirement with actorDecisionOwner '', visibility '', or orderedOperations [] must be rejected; derived requirement missing finite-supply/impossible-instruction/partial-resolution fields must be rejected.

new_findings.claim: audit-result.schema.json does not require verificationReviews to cover every critical, material, blocked, minor, and presentation-only discrepancy or preserved ambiguity/conflict disposition, despite Lane D requiring it.
evidence: audit-result.schema.json: verificationReviews is array items $ref verification with no minItems except allOf for status material-error/critical-error/source-blocked
audit-result.schema.json: verification.reviewedDiscrepancyIds minItems 1 but no cross-field constraint that all non-match discrepancies are covered
methodology.md: 'Lane D ... checks direct source evidence for: every critical, material, blocked, minor, and presentation-only discrepancy; every preserved ambiguity or conflict disposition...'
new_findings.failure_mode: A unit result with an unreviewed material or minor discrepancy can pass schema and, if the decision evaluator only checks the clean-match sample, can reach final without independent verification.
new_findings.required_fix: Add a validator cross-field constraint: every discrepancy with severity != none and every preserved ambiguity/conflict disposition must appear in at least one verificationReviews[].reviewedDiscrepancyIds; reject otherwise.
new_findings.test_or_negative_control: Mutation test: audit result with a material discrepancy and empty verificationReviews under status compared must be rejected.

residual_limitations: The 17/17 and 6/6 test bodies are omitted from the supplied packet; only the summary is available, so mutation coverage cannot be independently confirmed from these bytes.

audit-lock.json, validate_correctness_audit.py, advance_correctness_audit_progress.py, and evaluate_correctness_audit.py are not supplied; cross-file checks are evidenced only by methodology and test summary.
source-packet.schema.json does not require faqUnitIdsChecked to be nonempty when applicable FAQ units exist, and componentChannelsChecked is not linked to specific evidence items.
The audit remains a non-probability sample; the approximately 199 unaudited primary component-effect units remain outside any Stage 1 pass claim.
The revised harness is not an overengineered semantic system; the remaining risk is under-enforced cross-field invariants rather than semantic expansion.
